title: Hunt for Red Raktuber
start: Talk to Larry at the Ardougne Zoo.

items.t: 1 silk, 1 plank and 1 clockwork to make one
4 normal planks (protean planks do not work)
Nothing equipped in the main hand, off-hand and back slots

recommended.t: Clocktower Teleport scrolls for quick access to Larry
A Dramen or lunar staff for fairy ring teleport to the Rellekka Hunter area (DKS), unless you have completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
Watchtower Teleport or ring of duelling to Castle Wars
Yanille tablet after completing Love Story quest
A way to recover run energy, such as resting, an explorer's ring, energy potions, and super energy potions
If As a First Resort is completed, the salt-water spring in the Oo'glog gives unlimited run energy for up to 24 minutes
The spa pool in the Anachronia base camp
Do not take armour or weapons as no combat is involved. Familiars are also not recommended as they cannot be taken into some of the quest areas

rewards.t: Access to the Penguin Hunter area

A Penguin Hide and Seek Distraction and Diversion bonus. A polar bear can be spotted once each week. Its location is the same on every world. It hides inside a well and pops up every few seconds. Inspect the well to spy on the polar bear for 1 penguin point.
Chuck the Polar Bear, located in a cage just south-east of the Penguin enclosure, replaces Larry in the Penguin Hide and Seek activity. At this time, Larry cannot be accessed.
Puffer, Ray, Octopus, and Monkfish hats.

steps.t: Talk to Larry in the south-west of the Ardougne Zoo and agree to help. [Chat: 1 Hunt for Red Raktuber › Accept]
Go east to the south coast of Witchaven, and inspect one of the giant footprints on the western side of the southern coast.
p: Showing the Chief Zookeeper the footprint in Witchaven

steps.t: Return to Larry for a cutscene. [Chat: 1 Hunt for Red Raktuber]
North-east of Rellekka (north of Fremennik lodestone), travel via the small boat to the Iceberg.
Talk to Larry. [Chat: 1 Alright, I guess so.]

sub.t: You should now be in the penguin suit.

steps.t: North-west, investigate the avalanche, a patch of snow up against the ice wall.

Enter the west room, speak to KGP Interrogator. [Chat: 1 Yes, I am. › 1 My captain trusted me to deliver the message. › 2 Your captain must trust you a great deal. › 1 My captain found a greater leader. › 3 What leader could possibly be greater than the Pescaling. › 2 The sea may control your Captain, but he controls your life. › 1 He will bring unity by destroying the humans. › 3 Why not unite all penguins to The Sea, first. › 2 He's only demonstrating his impatience. › 1 Nothing can stop him › 2 If he comes to rescue you, he'll be captured. › 1 'Our sacrifice'? Only you appear to be making the sacrifice.]
Talk to captured penguin and note down the three dance emotes.
Search the crate behind you to get a conch shell, puffer, octopus, monkfish, and a ray.

sub.t: You may fail, just try again.

steps.t: Take note of which headwear the captured penguin is wearing.

sub.t: The fish hat will either be a puffer, octopus, monkfish, or ray fish.

steps.t: Talk to Ping & Pong (who are in a room north-east from interrogation room).
Talk to the KGP Agent by the control panel to the north, he is tucked behind a corner wall.
Return to Ping & Pong. [Chat: 4 Chicklings › 5 Squirrels › 1 Blue › 3 Bears › 4 Kiss › 2 Sharks › 1 Yes, that sounds great!]
Return to the KGP Agent by the control panel. Sing him the lullaby. [Chat: 2 I want to sing you a song.]
p: A KGP Agent falls asleep after you sing him a lullaby.

steps.t: Operate the control panel. Head north-east into the war room.
Talk to any dwarf. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Speak to the dwarf again.
Exit war room to get caught.
Talk to Larry (twice). [Chat: 1 Alright, I guess so.]
Re-enter the hideout via the avalanche and return to the dwarves. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to them again and give them the supplies to get a toolbox.
Perform practice run on the engine panel north of the dwarves.

sub.t: Click bellows twice, the pressure gauge will point to the red.
Turn valve wheel three times, the pressure gauge arrow points straight up in the green.

steps.t: Talk to a dwarf again. [Chat: 2 No.]
Exit war room to get caught.
Talk to Larry. [Chat: 1 Alright, I guess so.]
North-west, talk to Noodle. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Re-enter the hideout via the avalanche. Enter first room to the east (second door to the east, first is decorative).
p: A map of the office, showing the route to the sorting table.

steps.t: Navigate to the sorting table without being spotted using the picture to the right (see the full guide for more details).
Search sorting table to get a telegram. Exit the small room and ensure the door is closed before you move further.

Navigate back out of the office the way you came, without being spotted. Once back in the main hall, exit using the southern door. If you are caught you will lose the item and have to repeat the process.
Return to Larry and talk to him twice.
Southeast of Yanille, just outside the city walls, talk to Larry. [Chat: 1 Alright, I guess so.]
Enter the penguin suit and wear the fish hat the captured penguin was wearing.
Blow the conch shell, then perform the three emotes.
p: A player blowing a conch shell

steps.t: Climb up the ladder and walk all the way to the east, opening doors along the way.
Talk to Captain Marlin behind the red curtain.
Pick either honest or lie. [Chat: Any]
In the brig, walk west and search the hatstand to get an electric eel, shark tooth, crab claw, seaweed, and a swordfish.
Open the east door.
Inspect the engine panel.

sub.t: Click pufferfish twice, the pressure gauge will point to the red.
Octopus -> Turn valve wheel three times, the pressure gauge arrow points straight up in the green.

steps.t: Talk to Chuck towards the east side of the island to leave the island and get a cutscene.

sub.t: If you teleport off the island, talk to Chuck at the Ardougne Zoo to get teleported back to the Desert Island and talk to him again once there.

p: A most unconventional method of transportation

steps.t: Quest complete!
